The bonus is valid from August 6 to August 13, 2026.
To get 20 free spins, you must place a deposit of at least €80 with code NEW.
To get 40 free spins, you must place a deposit of at least €150 with code NEW.
Each bonus can be activated only once during the promotion period.
Full wagering requires making bets as follows:
• 20 free spins bonus — wager 30 times the amount of winnings received from the free spins.
• 40 free spins bonus — wager 25 times the amount of winnings received from the free spins.
The free spins bonus is valid for 5 days, starting from the date you receive it.
The maximum bet amount when wagering is €20.
The maximum amount that can be transferred to your real balance after wagering is completed is:
• 20 free spins bonus — €400.
• 40 free spins bonus — €750.
Any winnings above the applicable maximum win limit will be forfeited.
Free spins are available on The Dog House Megaways by Pragmatic Play or Savage Buffalo Spirit Megaways by BGaming, depending on the bonus configuration.
The value of each free spin is €1.
If the player's active balance is in another currency, the free spin value, minimum deposit and maximum win limits will be converted into the equivalent amount in the player's active currency.
You can activate your free spins in the Bonus section of your account.
The player can receive a manually credited deposit bonus only if the qualifying deposit amount remains unchanged. In the rare event that the bonus is not granted automatically after a qualifying deposit, please contact Customer Support before placing any bets. The bonus cannot be credited manually if any part of the qualifying deposit has already been used.
Activating this promotion indicates acceptance of Boho's General Bonus Terms and Conditions.
